total_weight_is_zero.meaning: IVoter(voter).totalWeight() equals zero at the time notifyRewardAmount transfers rewards

pool_live_weight_is_zero.meaning: the pool's live weight equals zero when _updateForAfterDistribution runs

emissions_wedged_indefinitely.meaning: minted emissions remain wedged inside GaugeManager indefinitely, never reaching gauges and never returning to the minter
emissions_wedged_indefinitely.checkpoint: after notifyRewardAmount transfer and _updateForAfterDistribution for the zero-weight pool

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount transfers rewards into GaugeManager for the epoch in question
_updateForAfterDistribution runs for the pool with zero live weight after the transfer

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the zero-weight scenario was observed in a live transaction or is only conditional, nor the exact epoch range affected.

limitations: Formalizes only the emissions_wedged_indefinitely impact; other reported impacts are handled in separate passes.
The wedged/returned outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric amount or time bound for the indefinite stranding.
